references.title: Swap rows
references.definition: Exchange two whole rows. The equations change places and keep the same solutions.
references.rule: Ri <-> Rj. Include every entry, including the right-hand value.

references.title: Divide a row
references.definition: Divide every entry in one row by the same nonzero number. The other row stays unchanged.
references.rule: Ri' = Ri / k, k != 0. This is row scaling by 1/k.

references.title: Add a row multiple
references.definition: Add a multiple of one row to another. Use matching columns and keep the source row unchanged. A negative multiple subtracts.
references.rule: Ri' = Ri + k Rj, i != j. Include the right-hand value.
